data.name: Mujirah
data.gender_notes: Mujirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who strives and struggles in the way of Allah. Derived from the Arabic root 'j-r-h' which means to strive or to struggle. The name Mujirah carries the meaning “Struggler, Fighter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mujirah usually hope their child will grow to embody struggler, fighter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes dedication and perseverance in one's faith.
data.etymology: Mujirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Struggler, Fighter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mujirah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mujirah carries a powerful cultural impact as it signifies a strong and dedicated individual who is committed to their faith and works towards improving their community and society as a whole. This name evokes the image of someone who is selfless, passionate, and willing to go above and beyond to make a positive difference in the world, especially in the context of the Islamic community.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mujirah lies in its reminder of the fundamental Islamic principle of striving and struggling in the way of Allah. This name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of devoting one's time, energy, and resources to the service of Allah and the betterment of humanity. Mujirah embodies the idea of "doing good" as a means of pleasing Allah and earning rewards in both this world and the next. It is a name that inspires its bearer to be a source of positive change and a beacon of spiritual light in the world.
